violations.why: The higher-priority communicate ISR can reset tickCounter between the increment and the read into tmp_tickCounter in the measure ISR.
The communicate ISR can write tickCounter between the measure ISR's read and its later overwrite at line 81.
The communicate ISR can reset numberOfRecords after the measure ISR has used it as an index. The measure ISR's increment then overwrites the reset value.
numberOfRecords can change between the index read at line 83 and the read in the increment at line 85, so the record slot and the counter become inconsistent.
The communicate ISR can write intervalCounter between the read and write halves of the non-atomic increment, so its update is lost.
